notes.title: Windows 11 Support
notes.notes: We've dusted off Hunt: the Unknown Quarry and updated it to run on Windows 11.

notes.title: June Update
notes.notes:
Hunt has been updated with several new animations to help players follow the action as the game unfolds.  These enhanced visuals are used for searching, rolling the die, spending energy, and more.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605826/a697b526c66cd2da324f4a5e728658d9e63dacdc.gif[/img] [img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605826/ba83a62c3661e20796b9933c82dab3ea40bf820a.gif[/img]


We've also added a new button on several panels that can be used to automatically record the details to your notepad.  For instance, after searching a room, you can use this button to record all the cards you saw.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605826/8f8b0568acc8f339d7908e451757cea1dc785976.gif[/img]


When pointing at the cards in your notepad, you'll also be able to see an image of the card to remind you what it does.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27605826/12a84055c5cfe39b28b79b2f3bc074e9972949ca.gif[/img]
